style_profile.name: Editorial Flash Candid
style_profile.director_intent: Attention lands face-first via frontal flash pop, then drops to the single saturated hero accent, then hands. Hard 5500K flash plus normal 35mm lens creates confrontational intimacy that reads honest rather than produced. Flat wall + fine digital grain signals contemporary editorial taste. To reuse: keep frontal flash with wall-shadow falloff, centered medium shot, one hero-color pop; vary everything else.
style_profile.transferable_dna: centered flash-frozen medium shot on flat wall, 35mm deep focus, hard 5500K frontal flash at 4:1, neutral palette with one saturated accent, pores-and-knit tactility, candid snapshot energy
non_negotiables: on-camera direct flash with visible wall shadow
single saturated hero accent on neutral ground

subject.description: young ceramicist in clay-dusted apron holding a small glazed vase, neutral expression, direct gaze

master_prompt: Direct-flash digital editorial photograph of a young ceramicist in a clay-dusted canvas apron holding a small glazed vase at chest height, neutral expression with direct gaze into lens, centered waist-up medium shot against a flat warm-beige gallery wall filling the frame edges. Shot on a 35mm normal prime at f/2.0 with deep flash-frozen focus, face and vase tack-sharp, faint hard-edged shadow thrown onto the wall behind. Hard on-camera flash at 5500K over dim 3200K room ambience, 4:1 contrast with crisp nose-shadow falloff and small hotspot sheen on forehead, round flash catchlights. Neutral flash-balanced grade with warm amber skin, restrained neutrals and one saturated glazed-teal vase accent. Visible skin pores, coarse canvas apron weave, matte drywall grain, ultra-fine digital grain with dust specks, clean dry air, contemporary candid intimacy, generous wall negative space, snapshot-frozen instant.
